symptom: Adding the multimap victory terminal model as a caramel-workshop-only terminal_conversion_branch in the 210-300s late window did not convert caramel-workshop to a 300s victory. The 300s high-pressure result stayed soda-creek 1.0, caramel-workshop 0.0, cracked-star-jar 0.3333, while caramel-workshop average survival dropped from the per-map chain baseline 231.2871s to 228.9533s.
root_cause: The terminal branch plumbing and per-map dispatch are working, but the existing multimap victory terminal model does not contain a useful caramel-workshop late conversion sequence for the actual failure states. In the 300s comparison the branch dispatched 796 times on caramel-workshop, including 796 late-window decisions, yet produced no win and introduced a small survival regression.
fix: Do not continue tuning the same terminal dispatch window or thresholds as a promotion path. Keep the per-map edge branch plus all-map late filter as the current no-regression diagnostic baseline, then collect or train a caramel-workshop-specific late conversion target closer to the failing 210-300s states before any further policy candidate evaluation.
validation: Ran high-pressure 60s, 180s, and 300s comparisons on seeds 63400-63402 using e30 mid-anchor parent, terminal_victory_multimap_path_target_w1_e30 as a caramel-workshop-only terminal_conversion_branch with map override 210-300s / min_pressure 0.2 / min_low_health_risk 0.25, soda-creek 0-60s and caramel-workshop 30-45s edge branch map overrides, and all-map late_recovery_filter from 60s. window_regression_vs_per_map_chain.json failed with one blocker: 300s/caramel-workshop average survival dropped 2.3338s.
